findings.title: The packaged app shipped the design skill without its instructions
evidence: output/folio-p2/cli-files-missing-before-fix.txt — 13 files absent from the pre-fix package (SKILL.md, all references/*.md, examples/minimal/*, the pinned DeepSeek preset skills)
After the fix the package carries 16 design-skill files (SKILL.md, 4 references, 4 scripts, examples/minimal/*, both imagegen skills)
Live behaviour: before the fix the agent said "No SKILL.md exists — let me inspect the scripts"; after it, "Now reading the skill references and inspecting the reference image."
findings.cause: electron-builder treats one positive `files` pattern as the whole include set; the `!**/*.{md,markdown,mkd}` and `!examples/**` source-tree exclusions reached into staged `resources/cli` build output and stripped markdown and example trees the skill ships.

findings.title: An open design canvas is not repainted after a committed turn
evidence: Reproduced in two independent sessions. Negative session: receipt committed 1f315106…, on-disk design.json digest 1f315106… with background #FDF3E3 and 10 elements, result card reading "Committed — This turn's design was saved to the canvas." — while the visible canvas stayed blank white and the Edit tools CANVAS BACKGROUND field read #ffffff (AXTextField @1628,715).

negative/agent-preview-of-repaired-turn.png and negative/canvas-view-after-committed-turn.png are byte-identical (acea99b1…): the document the agent rendered and the document the desktop exports are the same, and the canvas view is the one that lags.
Positive session: adding an element after the commit produced a bare DESIGN_CONFLICT in the canvas status area, with no i18n key and no in-panel recovery control.
The embedded editor's conflict latch is permanent for that instance (packages/design-bento/src/product-session.ts:18,43,53,83), so Retry can never clear it.
⌘Q then raised the leave dialog and only "Discard edits" escaped it: the user cannot quit normally.
flushDesignCanvasBeforeSend (packages/components/src/lib/design-canvas-save-gate.ts:14) blocked the next send and surfaced the raw Error: DESIGN_CONFLICT.
Store safety held throughout: the committed poster was never overwritten; report/receipt/export all agreed. After a relaunch the same session rendered the committed design correctly.
findings.cause: No production path re-reads or rebases an open editor when a turn commits. The only readers are attachDesign on a cache miss (apps/electron/src/main/services/design-service.ts:146), reloadDesignCanvas from adoptDesignCandidate, and destroy-then-reattach.

findings.title: The OSS desktop cannot attach a reference image to a design turn
evidence: Attaching an image in the composer yields a "Failed" chip (use-chat-landing-image-draft.ts:128 requires a hosted authToken).
hasBlockingImages then blocks sending, and references[] stays empty because prompt images are read from the hosted session-image store.
The acceptance journey therefore supplied the reference by absolute path in the prompt and the local agent read it from disk, which is the only OSS path that works today.

notes: Composition matches the reference hierarchy: navy/amber top band, accent circle, headline, date line, three body lines, two footer blocks.
Exported PNG measured: footer block rows 547-574 (centre 560.5) against label ink rows 559-572; the labels sit slightly above the vertical centre of their blocks.
The agent noticed the same thing and nudged the labels (the two agent previews differ only in rows 552-575) without fully centring them. Cosmetic, not a blocker.

limits: The reference image was supplied by absolute path in the prompt, not by attachment, because of finding P2-A3.
The three negative paths were driven by deliberately defective prompts (hand-written dangling media, an explicit cancel), not by natural failures.
screencapture is unavailable to the harness process, so live-state evidence is a computer-use accessibility dump plus on-disk artifacts and the product's own exports rather than window screenshots.
The journey ran on the configured local agent; no additional paid model call was made for retries, per the agent-naive rule.
The packaging finding is fixed and verified in this work; P2-A2 and P2-A3 are recorded, not fixed.
